articles.title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
articles.description:
Crochet pitched out of the bullpen with the White Sox for multiple seasons before being traded to Boston.

The post Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role? appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Garrett Crochet, traded to Boston, may return to the bullpen for the Red Sox.
Crochet previously pitched for the White Sox, enhancing Boston's pitching depth.
His return could strengthen the Red Sox's bullpen ahead of the 2026 season.

articles.title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
